policy.text: Students must maintain at least 80% attendance in each course to be eligible for examinations. Exceptional circumstances may be considered through formally approved exceptions.
policy.purpose: Improve class participation, encourage consistent attendance and maintain academic standards.
policy.environment: One institution and one course over a term. Students include a long-distance commuter, a resident student, a student with fixed work hours and a student with family responsibilities. Faculty, an academic advisor, an attendance administrator and an examination officer are involved. Transport disruptions happen during the term. The attendance office can process only a few exception requests a week, and eligibility is checked at a set point in the term.
